question: Why is the Raudraraudreśvarī form held as desired by the best gurus?
premises: Raudraraudreśvarī is the form that has come forth.
This coming forth makes that form especially valued.
The best gurus therefore desire this form.
inference: Because Raudraraudreśvarī has manifested in this way, the best gurus regard her as the desired form.
plain_english: The Raudraraudreśvarī who came forth is therefore desired by the best gurus.
